name: solar-chain-bidir-v1
description: SolarRenderer (MiniMax-H3 + control and 4-step LoRAs) rendering a whole episode as chained bidirectional windows. Task-independent starting point, not a qualification: a new task still needs its own full-episode canary and independent blind review.
carrier: plain T-layout white carrier at the episode frame rate, frames map 1:1 (no tail pad, no wide wrist)
first_frame: real episode frame 0 in the carrier's T layout (solar_first_frame.py)

prompt.form: SolarRenderer caption skill, six parts, first-frame kind full

handover.mask: lit-display detector or an explicit mask

review: independent blind review per evaluations/render-h3/ on the stitched video against the carrier; seams and hand-over frames are part of the review
